result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual: a long company-history timeline and promotional headlines dominate. Aspirational claims appear in the Innovative and Culture sections, using first-person plural 'we' in the culture block. Employee and recruiting prompts are addressed to prospective workers. Commitments are mostly unhedged, with few specific values beyond innovation.
